timer.mode_busy: Toast when the user picks Stopwatch / Pomodoro / Timer in Change widget type while the current one is running or paused partway. Tells them to stop and reset it first.
timer.presets_menu: Timer widget right-click submenu listing the quick-start durations (Settings › Timer). Picking one sets that time and starts the timer. Short.
sw.cat_menu: Stopwatch right-click submenu to pick the time category (Focus / Other). One word.
sw.reset_total_menu: Stopwatch right-click item: the category total starts counting from zero now. Nothing is deleted; the log keeps all past time. Short.
sw.laps_menu: Stopwatch right-click submenu listing the recorded laps. {n} is how many. Short.
pomo.settings_menu: Pomodoro right-click item that opens its settings panel (lengths, rounds, auto-start). Ends with an ellipsis like other items that open a panel.
